name: Wearing Hell
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level bard 4, medium 4, mesmerist 4, psychic 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 mins./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You take on the form of a devil one size category larger or smaller than yourself. You cannot look like a specific devil, but otherwise you can give your devil form unique features.

The spell does not provide the abilities or mannerisms of the chosen devil, nor does it alter the perceived tactile (touch). However, the sounds created by your equipment are masked and you make any natural, or ambient, sounds of the chosen devil. You gain a +10 bonus a the Disguise check to impersonate as a devil. A creature that interacts with the glamer gets a Will save to recognize it as an illusion.

Additionally, your presence instills fear in mortals that perceive you. Any non-outsider that sees you and is within 30 feet must make a Will save or be shaken for 1 round/level. If the target is under 5 HD, they are frightened for 1d4 rounds before becoming shaken for 1 round/level. This fear portion of the spell is a mind-affecting, fear effect.
